messages:
Ivy (CS): Capture from VendorHealth procurement call — two immediate asks blocking signature: reliable export_id and route-level cost lines in CSV. They said no go without these.
Ivy (CS): Verbatim: "We require a stable export_id and per-route rows so our ledger can map costs. Until then procurement won't sign."
Lena (AM): This is high risk for renewal — procurement wants a sample CSV before EOD Friday.
Rahul (PM): Triage: export_id+route rows = P0. Short-term mitigation: manual reconciled CSV + README. Long-term: console column + export API.
Sam (Eng): Quick tech note: exporter is infra/exporter-service. Adding columns is small. I can generate a manual reconciled CSV from staging if I get the sample. Suggest export_id = sha256(job_id + timestamp).
Ivy (CS): I'll upload the customer's sample export and the auditor checklist now. Also capturing example truncated note they reported.
Sam (Eng): For the truncation, can you attach the longest template they use? I can run a repro and check seq-length.
ops-bot: Created tasks VH-1201 (manual-reconciled-csv), VH-1202 (add-export-id-and-route-columns), VH-1203 (transcript-truncation-investigation) and linked to account "VendorHealth-Pilot". VH-1202 flagged P0.
Lena (AM): Short-term ask: Ivy, please get the sample posted and confirm procurement contact. If manual CSV goes out today we can ask them to sign pending full fix.
Rahul (PM): Owners: Sam owns VH-1202+VH-1203, Ivy owns VH-1201 and customer comms, I'll coordinate prioritization and add renewal-risk tag.
Sam (Eng): I can produce manual CSV in ~3h after sample. Will add per-route aggregation and stable export_id.
Ivy (CS): Uploaded files and pinged procurement. Scheduling a 15m demo for tomorrow 9am PT to walk through the manual CSV.
Rahul (PM): We'll review progress in tomorrow standup and decide whether to slot VH-1202 into next sprint. Thanks team :thumbsup:
